Row-group facts encoded here: THHN, THWN, and THWN-2 share one printed row group (values duplicated under each key on purpose); XHHW-2 shares the XHH/XHHW row group; TW and THW share one printed row group for 14–8 AWG (14 AWG printed as 'TW, XF, XFF, THHW, THW, THW-2'; 12–8 as 'TW, THHW, THW, THW-2') and both merge with the RHH*/RHW* group at 6 AWG and larger — do NOT confuse the nearby 'RHH*, RHW*, RHW-2*' 14–8 rows (13.48/16.77/21.48/35.87), which are a different row group. UF and USE are cable types with no Chapter 9 Table 5 rows and are intentionally absent — the engine rejects them for conduit-fill purposes.
